declarations.name: Theorem G1. Every polynomial passport is a colored period diagonal
declarations.scope: For every minimal polynomial passport with a distinguished branch, df/f identifies its exact grouped-value locus with a colored integer-relative-period diagonal in a nonresonant, vertically generic genus0 isoresidual fiber. Same-color periods are integers and different-color periods are not integers. With all labels it is a smooth complex locus of dimension r-2. Full branch conventions require the stated finite label-forgetting quotient, including re-rooting f->f-f(z_j) if the distinguished type repeats.

declarations.name: Theorem G2. A finite rational-cell reduction for the distinguished branch
declarations.scope: The distinguished-branch colored period locus has a finite rational-cell reduction using the actual CMST2026 period model. Each transverse width is at most N by the polynomial lemniscate degree bound; tree periods have absolute real part at most(n-1)N. Subdivide the finite primary period domains and gluing faces by integer real levels and imaginary zero levels, retain exactly valid colored cells, exclude metric-completion collisions, and take incidence components. This is a written finite reduction, not implemented global graph enumeration and not a solved arbitrary-passport classification.

declarations.name: Theorem G3. Canonical cyclic power extraction and phase data
declarations.scope: For any chosen branch partition lambda, D=gcd(lambda) canonically gives f=h^D up to scaling. For D>1 the standard D-block quotient is cyclic and only that branch acts on it. Same-color critical-point ratios h(z_j)/h(z_i) are locally constant Dth-root phases, equivalently integer relative periods modD. Their bins give cyclically ordered return cycle types. At most one finite branch has all parts with a common divisor>1. These phases neither determine every block system nor classify all components.

declarations.name: Theorem G4. Exact algebraic form of the cubic degree-eight pair
declarations.scope: All degree8 polynomials of passport(4,2,2),(2,2,1^4), modulo source/target affine changes, have explicit representatives(z^4+z^2)^2 or[z^2(z^2+z+b)]^2 with b=(9+/-3sqrt3)/16. The latter two share phase(T,T), identical actual H576 and intrinsic classes, deck1/literal16 each, and are separated by the previously proved genuine cubic invariant. The even representative has phase(DT,I), deck2/literal8, group64. Algebraic remainder/critical-value identities prove completeness; the retained exact L8/D5 tables identify actual monodromy and lifts.
